title: Still looking for feedback on my University Tycoon game, UniSchool
author: OakReyes
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/rhlry8fp121i1.png

I've been working on this for a few months and I'm starting to have blind spots for what needs improvement. Any advice is welcome!

  
Play in your browser here (desktop recommended): [https://halifaxgames.itch.io/unischool](https://halifaxgames.itch.io/unischool)

  
This is the first game I've tried to build. I've had this idea for a game for years. I loved playing Rollercoaster Tycoon, Football Manager, the Sims, Cities: Skylines, and never found a simulation game for building a university that scratched the itch. I know Two Point Campus exists, but it wasn't what I was looking for. So, I started building a game in my own vision, with limited development experience and on top of a full-time job. It has been a great learning process, and getting this far would have taken me years (if ever) without AI assistance. Still lots left to polish. I'm working with an artist to provide capsule artwork, and a composer I found on Reddit did the title screen music, with hopefully more to come.

  
I would appreciate leaving feedback at the link in the game menu, but any comments here are welcome too!
